summary: Axe Compute Inc. filed an 8-K to announce a prospectus supplement updating its at-the-market (ATM) offering program with H.C. Wainwright as sales agent. The maximum aggregate sales amount is now $100 million, with $12.7 million sold in the prior 12 months. No new special-situation event occurred; this is a routine shelf takedown update. The filing includes a legal opinion from Lucosky Brookman LLP. There is no merger, tender, restructuring, or other special situation—only an ordinary capital markets transaction.
